ai_summary: Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL) experienced a material decline in its Q1 FY27 financial performance, with standalone revenue from operations dropping approximately 35% year-over-year and net profit falling sharply by about 45%, primarily due to reduced transaction and IPO/Corporate Action income. While the company continued to expand its demat accounts, surpassing 10.60 crore, this significant contraction in profitability serves as a key red flag, warranting further investigation into the underlying market conditions impacting its core revenue streams.
